data.why: The GUI has no file-upload widgets anywhere; every page is driven by text fields (a project label and a CATMA access token) and session state, and the only bundled test fixtures (gitma_canspin/tests/canspin/) are read by pytest, not by the Streamlit app, so there is nothing file-like to hand the browser.

goals: register a CATMA annotation project in the GUI so its collections become available for downstream processing
export a loaded annotation collection to basic/annotated token TSV and TEI-conformant XML for use in training classifiers
compute descriptive statistics and pie/bar-chart visualizations of annotation class distributions across a corpus
calculate inter-annotator agreement (gamma metric) across two or more annotation collections
build a strict-mode gold-standard annotation collection from overlapping annotator collections

review.summary: The tree accurately and verifiably records a smoke test of the project-registration gate: the screens match, and the raw ProxyError finding is real. But it treats the gate as the goal, fills a phase with Streamlit chrome, and leaves out every export, analysis and gold-standard stage the README describes. Reframe the goal, prune the click-level tasks, add the folder-picker step, and mark the downstream stages as unreached or placeholders before filing.
